subject: Urgent: MAP slippage impacting evaluation window
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@verdeai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@verdeai.com>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Revised MAP and timeline concerns

Naomi —

Thanks for the MAP you shared last week. We've reviewed the milestones with our internal eval committee and there are two items that will push our final sign-off beyond the committed close date: an additional security review (SOC evidence gap) and a last-minute workload validation that requires a scaled soak run.

Draft impact: the evaluation window needs to extend by ~10 business days to complete the soak and produce the performance report. That moves our request for final approval into the week of Aug 25, which conflicts with the current close target.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can (a) run an accelerated soak with dedicated capacity, or (b) accept a formal two-week extension to the MAP and amend terms? We need a short note for procurement to expedite a contract amendment if the latter is required — they asked for an action owner by end of day.

I've attached the updated schedule we prepared (Evaluation_Schedule_v2.xlsx) and a short list of the required SOC artifacts.

Appreciate quick confirmation —
Sarah

--
Sarah Lim
Head of Integrations, Verde AI
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@verdeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Aug 2025 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Revised MAP and timeline concerns

Sarah — thanks for the clear breakdown and for flagging procurement's need for an owner. We own this. Short answers up front: we can offer an accelerated soak with dedicated instances for the core workload and we are also prepared to execute a two-week formal extension if you prefer contract amendment.

Immediate actions I propose:
- Redwood will provision a dedicated pool for the soak (2 x A100 equivalent) to run an accelerated validation starting next Tue (Aug 12).
- I'll attach our current MAP risk log and mark the SOC artifact delivery as a gate that will require a one-time evidence upload to your portal.
- Procurement owner: Ben Carter (cc'd). He can coordinate the amendment and DocuSign paperwork if Verde chooses the extension.

Please confirm which path you want (accelerated soak run vs. formal 2-week MAP extension). If you choose the extension, we'll prepare an amendment and Ben will push the DocuSign link. If you choose accelerated soak, we'll schedule the kick-off and capture pass/fail criteria in the MAP.

Attaching: MAP_Risk_Log_20250807.csv

Naomi
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Subject: Escalation: Verde AI MAP slip — exec note

Jonas —

Bringing this to you because Verde's evaluation committee found two blockers that will likely push final approval beyond our committed close date. We have two mitigation options: (1) Redwood runs an accelerated soak on dedicated capacity starting Aug 12 (we absorb incremental infra cost for one soak run) or (2) we execute a two-week MAP extension and amend the contract (procurement prefers this route for auditability).

Why escalate: procurement asked for an exec-level signoff on any extension or cost absorption given the deal size and the originally agreed close date. Verde's procurement has requested a named owner and a DocuSign amendment if they take the extension.

Recommendation: approve either a) a no-cost one-off dedicated soak (Redwood covers infra for the soak) to preserve the original close cadence, or b) allow Ben to execute a 2-week amendment with a small extension fee (we'd take a modest concession on T&Cs).

Desired: your quick OK on which path we should offer (I prefer option a to keep momentum). If you agree, I'll message Verde and schedule the soak. If you prefer option b, Ben will proceed with DocuSign and I'll update the MAP.

Attachments: MAP_Risk_Log_20250807.csv

Thanks —
Naomi
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
